reasoning_summary: SARS-CoV-2 was identified as the biological agent with unresolved regulatory classification. Exposure was categorized as frequent based on provided information. Compliance was calculated as 83.33% (40 Yes / 48 applicable items), resulting in a 'partial' compliance class. Probability was derived as medium (value 3) from frequent exposure and partial compliance. GRB and risk class remain undetermined due to unresolved classification. Professional review is required to resolve classification and assess risk further.
